verdict.rationale: Databricks documents built-in AI assistants (Genie Code/Databricks Assistant and Genie) that write, run, fix, and explain SQL/code directly in the workspace, grounded in Unity Catalog schemas — e.g. 'integrated AI assistance' for SQL, inline suggestions, autonomous debugging, and natural-language data Q&A producing SQL/results. This is native, first-party functionality rather than a bolt-on tool. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of SQL-writing accuracy and no explicit example of 'explains SQL' phrasing beyond code comments/debugging.
